item.title: Indiana BMV Urges Hoosiers to Drive Sober this New Year’s Eve
item.description: The Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles reminds drivers to celebrate responsibly as Hoosiers prepare to ring in the new year.

item.title: South Bend Schools Set Public Hearing On Nearly-$300k Superintendent Contract
item.description: The South Bend Community School Corporation Board of Trustees will hold a public hearing next month on a proposed employment contract for the school district’s superintendent for the 2026-27 school year adding up to nearly $300,000.

item.title: Warsaw Rotary Club Collects $60,260.53 For The Salvation Army
item.description: The Warsaw Rotary Club held their annual “Rotary Salvation Army Day” and collected $60,260.53 to support the efforts of The Salvation Army in Kosciusko County.

item.title: Insurer Elevance Targets Out-Of-Network Care With Payment Cuts
item.description: Beginning Jan. 1, a subsidiary of Indianapolis-based Elevance Health plans to reduce reimbursement by 10% on commercial insurance claims when care is delivered by out-of-network clinicians at in-network hospitals.

item.title: BMV Shatters Kiosk Transaction Goal
item.description: The Indiana Bureau of Motor Vehicles has announced its goal of 1.45 million transactions at BMV Connect kiosks for the year has been broken by over a hundred thousand transactions, totaling over 1.55 million transactions.

item.title: Indiana Named ‘State Of The Year’
item.description: As first of a new tradition, The Washington Post editorial board named Indiana its inaugural “State of the Year” Monday, Dec. 23, citing the state’s refusal to adopt mid-decade congressional redistricting and several policy changes enacted over the past months.

item.title: Riley Staff Surprise Young Patient With Taylor Swift-Inspired Performance
item.description: A TikTok filmed inside a patient room at Riley Children’s Hospital has drawn national attention after hospital staff surprised a 12-year-old patient with a personalized performance inspired by Taylor Swift.
